# Everything about Action Points (AP) - Regeneration / Acceleration (with calculation formula)

![All about Action Points (AP) - Regeneration / Acceleration (with calculation formula)](/uploads/39_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Action Points (AP) Acceleration refers to the time in which your **action points are completely replenished** i.e. regenerated. This information is always given in seconds that are needed to fill the AP from 0% to 100%. By default this value is around 16 seconds. Perks, armor, mutations and buffs can increase this regeneration time to under 1 second. This regeneration works permanently (or as long as the buffs used) as long as the AP is not used. The regeneration only starts when you e.g. no longer shoots in VATS. Or stopped using the jetpack.

Dataminer "Thaang" in the "Fallout 76 Datamining Discord" has found numbers with which you can calculate the regeneration yourself.

The generation of action points e.g. through **canned coffee works differently**. see: Everything about canned coffee (action points bonus). And the Max AP must also be considered separately from the acceleration. The maximum action points have no influence on acceleration.

Action points acceleration calculator on our website: AP calculator

## ACTIONPOINTSRATE

This is the basic AP regeneration. Measured by percent of AP per second. The buffs stack additively with a few exceptions. **Default: 6** (no limit)

- 
Armor with AP (per piece, stacks) 
 Value added:**5**
- 
Power Armor Leg with Kinetic Servos (each, stacks) 
 Value added:**1**
- 
Power armor torso with optimized core 
 Value added:**6**
- 
Hard lemonade* 
 Value added:**10**
- 
Visitor tea * 
 Value added:**10**
- 
Visitor tea + herbivores * 
 Added value: **20** (**25** with "a dozen strange ones")
- 
corn soup * 
 Value added:**3**
- 
Corn soup with herbivores * 
 Added value: **6** (**7.5** with "Stranger by the dozen")
- 
Magazine: Love & Life 4 ** 
 Value added:**10**
- 
Magazine: pistols and cartridges 4 ** 
 Value added:**6**
- 
Revived by a player with "Syringe" perk (C) 
 Value added:**18**
- 
Nukashine (standard or vintage) 
 Value added:**50**

***** Visitor Tea does not stack with AP-regenerating food and drinks.

** Only one magazine can be active at the moment

## ACTIONPOINTSRATEMULT

Multiplies your total ActionPoints rate by the perks and temporary bonuses. These buffs stack additively with each other. **Default: 100** (no limit)

- 
Action Boy/Girl (Perk) 
 Value added:**45**
- 
Lone Wanderer (Perk) 
 Value added:**30**
- 
Nerd Rage (Perk) 
 Value added:**15**
- 
Well tuned (effect) 
 Value added:**25**
- 
Fully hydrogenated (effect) 
 Value added:**35** (**45** with Perk "Rejuvenated")

## FORMULA

[ActionPointsRate] * [ActionPointsRateMult] = [Percent of AP regenerated per second]

## EXAMPLES

**Without everything**

[6] * [100/100] = 6% per second

Full AP Regeneration: **16.6 seconds**

**With 3 AP armor pieces and nerd rage**

[6 + (3 * 5)] * [(100 + 15)/100] = 24.15% per second

Full AP Regeneration: **4.14 seconds**

**With 3 AP Armor pieces, Hard Lemonade, Action Boy, Nerd Rage, Fully Hydrated and Well Attuned**

[6 + (3 * 5) + 10] * [(100+15+25+35)/100] = 54.25% per second

Full AP Regeneration: **1.84 seconds**

## CONCLUSION

Our recommendation is still 3 pieces of armor with AP acceleration. Based on this list, you can now temporarily improve this regeneration if necessary.

On our website you will find an action points acceleration calculator with which you can calculate your optimal AP settings: https://nukaknights.com/fallout-76-aktionsstellen-ap-betreibungs-rechner.html
